title: Mandala 1: Agni Sukta
summary: Invocation of Agni, the divine priest and conveyer of offerings.
ai_summary: The first hymn of the Rigveda praises Agni as the ultimate divine priest who facilitates the connection between mortals and the cosmos.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्निमीळे पुरोहितं यज्ञस्य देवमृत्विजम् ।
होतारं रत्नधातमम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
agnimīḷe purohitaṃ yajñasya devamṛtvijam |
hotāraṃ ratnadhātamam ||
verses.translation: I glorify Agni, the high priest of the sacrifice, the divine, the ministrant, who is the offerer and supreme bestower of treasures.

layers.content: मैं अग्नि की स्तुति करता हूँ, जो यज्ञ के पुरोहित, देव, ऋत्विज, होता और रत्नों (संपत्ति) के उत्तम दाता हैं।
मी अग्नीची स्तुती करतो, जो यज्ञाचा पुरोहित, देव, ऋत्विज, आणि रत्ने (संपत्ती) देणारा श्रेष्ठ आहे.

layers.author: sayana
layers.content: Agni is placed at the forefront (purohitam) of all spiritual endeavors, representing the spark of cosmic intelligence.
